result.summary: Selected the official TACC Stampede3 User Guide landing page (docs.tacc.utexas.edu/hpc/stampede3/). The page appears to be a comprehensive user guide covering system architecture (node types including ICX, SPR, SKX, GPUs), network, file systems (Table 6), scratch purge policy, accessing the system (SSH), running jobs (sbatch, job scripts, queues—Table 8), job accounting, resource usage and allocation information, building software (compilers, MPI), launching applications (MPI, hybrid, interactive), and admin/help references.
unanswered_topics: Precise network performance metrics and topology (per-job network bandwidth, interconnect details beyond the 'Network' heading).
Concrete storage quota numbers and per-allocation/project default quotas (the headings list file systems but exact quota values may not be explicit).
External data transfer endpoints, recommended transfer tools (Globus/rsync) and any firewall or transfer restrictions.
Exact procedure and contacts for requesting node-specific allocations or excluding/targeting nodes (the guide warns against requesting specific nodes but may not detail approval process).
Any site-specific Slurm limits/quality-of-service details not in the Job Queues table (e.g., per-user job caps, max array sizes).
Credentials or local hostname details for interactive services (Jupyter/JupyterHub access endpoints) if not fully described on the page.
